svg.title: First seizure: history decides whether it was a seizure, then whether it was provoked; for an unprovoked seizure, MRI and EEG estimate the recurrence risk, which decides between discussing treatment for a single seizure and recommending it for epilepsy; drug-resistant epilepsy goes to an epilepsy centre; status epilepticus is an emergency; the epilepsy column ends with seizure types by onset, causes and comorbidities
